# git tools

Git operations - explore history, blame, diffs, and perform commits, branches, and pushes

36 tools. All categories: [MCP Tool Catalog](README.md).

## `close_pull_request`

Close (without merging) a GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request. Auto-detects forge type from the remote URL. Credentials are auto-fetched from stored git credentials.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [git/close_pull_request.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/git/close_pull_request.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string | yes | Repository alias |
| `number` | integer | yes | Pull/merge request number to close |

## `comment_on_pull_request`

Add a comment to a GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request. Supports both general conversation comments and inline review comments attached to a specific file and line.

- Permission: `query_repos`
- Source: [git/comment_on_pull_request.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/git/comment_on_pull_request.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string | yes | Repository alias |
| `number` | integer | yes | PR/MR number |
| `body` | string | yes | Comment text |
| `file_path` | string | no | File path for inline comment (optional; requires line_number) |
| `line_number` | integer | no | Line number for inline comment (required when file_path is provided) |

## `create_pull_request`

Create a GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request from a repository in write mode. Auto-detects forge type (github/gitlab) from the remote URL. Requires write mode to be active.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [git/create_pull_request.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/git/create_pull_request.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string | yes | Repository alias (must be in write mode) |
| `title` | string | yes | Pull/merge request title |
| `body` | string | no | Pull/merge request description (default: empty string) |
| `head` | string | yes | Source branch name (the branch with your changes) |
| `base` | string | yes | Target branch name (the branch to merge into) |
| `token` | string | no | Personal access token for forge API. |

## `git_amend`

Amend the most recent git commit. Can update the commit message or just re-commit staged changes with the existing message. Keeps the original author; the committer identity comes from your stored git credential.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [git/git_amend.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/git/git_amend.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string | yes | Repository alias |
| `message` | string | no | New commit message. |

## `git_push`

Push local commits to remote repository using your personal access token. Requires a git credential configured via configure_git_credential. Push uses HTTPS with PAT authentication; it does not change the author or committer of the commits being pushed.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [git/git_push.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/git/git_push.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string | yes | Repository alias |
| `remote` | string | no | Remote name (default: origin) |
| `branch` | string | no | Destination branch on the remote; the current HEAD is pushed to it (default: the currently checked-out branch). |
| `set_upstream` | boolean | no | Set upstream tracking after push (default: true). |
